integrity: The exact criterion follows directly from prime valuations of the divisor-count formula. The asymptotic is proved by elementary fixed-support smooth-number lattice counting and by showing the valuation inequalities exclude only a lower-order boundary set. Finite computation is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is for a fixed finite prime support only; no uniformity in varying support and no optimized effective error term are claimed. Earlier global tau-number literature is acknowledged, and residual risk remains for obscure equivalent formulations.
title: Fixed-prime-support asymptotics for refactorable numbers
